notes: The list already covers Glazunov's only original works for violin (Concerto Op. 82, Méditation Op. 32, Mazurka-Oberek) and the best-known violinist arrangements (Kreisler's Sérénade espagnole, the Raymonda Grand Adagio). I found no other established, published violin work or arrangement I could name with confidence, so nothing is added; his other solo string pieces (Élégie, Chant du ménestrel, the Op. 20 Mélodie) are for viola or cello and have no established violin versions.
